title: Switching a CNF to its Boolean dual
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $\{-1,1\}^n$, interpreted as a sign-valued Boolean function $f$. Regard its clauses as terms of a DNF formula. The resulting function at $x$ equals $-f(-x)$, where $-x$ negates every coordinate of $x$.
